subject: Insurance
title: Final Expense Insurance
description: A micro-lesson that makes Final Expense Insurance usable.

hook.text: Final expense insurance covers funeral costs. The average American funeral costs $8,000-$12,000.

buildup.text: These policies are small—$5,000 to $25,000—and require no medical exam. They're designed for simplicity.

discovery.text: Marketed heavily to seniors, final expense insurance is the fastest-growing segment.

twist.text: Critics say premiums are overpriced for the coverage.

climax.text: Final expense fills a real gap: families who can't save enough to bury their loved ones.

punchline.text: $10,000 for funeral costs. Final expense is simple, popular, and overpriced.

quiz.question: What does final expense insurance typically cover?
